title: The browser page title reads "Work In Progress - Report | ShopView"
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
2. Read the browser tab's page title.
custom_expected:
1. The browser page title is exactly "Work In Progress - Report | ShopView".
2. The separator is a plain hyphen with one space on each side (not a dash of another kind).
